title: Kite festival, Bandra field
cancellationNote: Called off if sustained wind is under 8 km/h. Kites need wind; there is no indoor version of this.

__meta.note: Invented instance. Kite festivals at this scale happen in Mumbai; these dates, the field and the capacity are not real.

title: Ghazal and qawwali night
cancellationNote: None. It is indoors and unamplified.

__meta.note: Invented operator. A small-room ghazal and qawwali programme of this shape exists in Fort; this hall and this schedule are not real.

title: Mehfil at the Dhow Foyer
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented operator and room.

title: Goan choir rehearsal, open door
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented programme. Parish choirs in Bandra do rehearse behind open doors; this one is not a real institution.

title: Sunday organ recital
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented programme. Tracker organs and Sunday recitals are real; this one is not a real listing.

title: Classical dance set, Bahar hall
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented hall and season.

title: Jazz corner, second set
cancellationNote: Rarely cancelled; the room is small enough that the musicians play to whoever is in it.

__meta.note: Invented venue.

title: Vinyl room, selector from nine
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented venue.

title: Basement gallery group show opening
cancellationNote: None, but expect a queue on the night. The room holds thirty and about seventy people come.

__meta.note: Invented gallery. `hours.raw` for the parent experience is deliberately unparsable, so the hours gate must treat this as unverified rather than assume it is open.

title: Open studio Friday, Erping Road lanes
cancellationNote: Reduced to one open studio if it rains; the lane has no cover.

__meta.note: Invented collective on a real lane.

title: Saturday life drawing on the steps
cancellationNote: Cancelled if it rains, and by eleven if the light goes hard.

__meta.note: Invented class.

title: Plein air sketching hour, promenade
cancellationNote: Cancelled if it rains.

__meta.note: Invented class.

title: Street photography walk, Causeway loop
cancellationNote: Cancelled if it rains. The leader messages the group by four in the afternoon.

__meta.note: Invented walk. One earlier season of this walk was cancelled with no message and two reviews mention it, which is why the cancellation note is explicit.

title: Long exposure evening, seawall
cancellationNote: Cancelled if there is cloud cover at sunset, which is most of the monsoon and some of December.

__meta.note: Invented class.

title: Monsoon film walk, wet-street reflections
cancellationNote: Called off in a downpour. Light rain is the point; a cloudburst is not.

__meta.note: Invented walk. It exists in the catalogue as a `covered` record so the monsoon weather gate does not throw away the street entirely in July.

title: Hill Road Sunday market
cancellationNote: Stalls do not set up in heavy rain; light drizzle is normal.

__meta.note: Real market on a real road. Weekly, so this is a schedule rather than a fiction.

title: Walkers Street flea
cancellationNote: Gone by two regardless. The lane clears early when it rains.

__meta.note: Real weekly market.

title: Juhu Sunday craft market
cancellationNote: Packs up early in rain.

__meta.note: Invented location. Sunday beach-road markets are real; this one is not a documented one.

title: Crawford Market late-afternoon trading
cancellationNote: Never cancelled; it is a roofed hall.

__meta.note: Real market. The record that should surface when a traveller asks for a flat, step-free, indoor option in Fort at four in the afternoon.

title: Covered market hall, Bandra West
cancellationNote: Open through the monsoon. This is the Bandra answer to it raining.

__meta.note: Invented hall. Deliberately modelled as a permanent roofed record with a long season so the rain replan has somewhere real to send people.

title: Koli community morning, Versova
cancellationNote: Called off if the sea is rough or if the catch has not landed. The family decide at four in the morning and message.

__meta.note: Invented programme. The Koli community and the Versova landing are real; this family's participation is not real and must not be presented as though it were.

title: Versova harbour boat morning
cancellationNote: Checked the night before. Rough sea means no trip and a full refund, and it happens more often than you would expect between May and September.

__meta.note: Invented route and vessel. Boats leave Versova in real life.

title: Kite making on the roof
cancellationNote: Wind is required, so a still day is as likely to cancel as a wet one.

__meta.note: Invented operator. Kite making is a real seasonal thing in Mumbai and this models a bookable version of it.

title: Letterpress bench, two hours
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented studio.

title: Hand loom hour
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented studio.

title: Pottery kiln day
cancellationNote: None, but the kiln has to be cool enough to load, so a hot week can push it to the following Saturday.

__meta.note: Invented studio. The 150-minute duration and the collect-in-weeks model are the point: this record must be rejected by the duration gate in any short window.

title: Stained glass bench
cancellationNote: None.

__meta.note: Invented studio.

title: Lantern making, Diwali season
cancellationNote: None, but the room is only stacked and interesting in the four weeks before Diwali. Outside that it is a workshop, not an event.

__meta.note: Invented operator. Modelled with a narrow season on purpose: it is the record that should be rejected on `seasonal_mismatch` if someone asks for lanterns in January.

title: Rickshaw canopy painting
cancellationNote: Called off if it rains; the bench is outside.

__meta.note: Invented operator. Rickshaw canopy painting is a real craft in this part of the city; this bench is not.

title: Sunrise yoga on the seawall
cancellationNote: Cancelled in rain, which in July is most mornings.

__meta.note: Invented class. Free, volunteer-run, and over-sixty friendly on purpose: several reviews make a point of that.

title: Bandstand sunset yoga
cancellationNote: Cancelled in rain.

__meta.note: Invented class.

title: Silent walk, Apollo Bandar
cancellationNote: Cancelled when it rains.

__meta.note: Invented class.

title: Novy Theatre play, evening
cancellationNote: Plays are cancelled more often than venues admit. Ask before you build a plan on it.

__meta.note: Real theatre, invented running production and dates.

title: Film screening, marble foyer
cancellationNote: Never; it is the rain plan.

__meta.note: Real cinema, invented programme listing. The 150-minute duration is what the short-window scenarios must reject.

title: Film screening, Bandra art deco house
cancellationNote: Never.

__meta.note: Invented cinema.

title: Novelty Theatre Sunday matinee
cancellationNote: Separate booking from the evening show; do not assume one ticket works for both.

__meta.note: Invented production.

title: Rangoli and lantern evening, mosque lane
cancellationNote: Stalls thin out in rain; the shrine itself is unaffected.

__meta.note: Invented. Modelled as a real seasonal density spike in a place most products would never send a crowd-sensitive traveller, so the crowd penalty has something true to work with.

title: Backbay heritage walk, sunset
cancellationNote: Called off in rain, and there is no toilet on the route in any weather.

__meta.note: Invented tour.

title: Wada room open hours
cancellationNote: A caretaker is present or it is shut. There is no published schedule and no way to check in advance.

__meta.note: Invented property. No published schedule exists, which one review complains about directly.

title: Cinema and food court, cinema special
cancellationNote: Fully booked on Christmas Eve. A sold-out day is the fixture the capacity and sold-out scenarios should be built against.

__meta.note: Invented. Deliberately near-capacity: this is the event the `sold_out` rejection code should be demonstrable against.
